newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly lower, gas oil off sharply.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly lower, gas oil off sharply.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly lower on Monday, gas oil particularly so, traders said.
Gas oil slid by up to $8 on the back of weaker futures, while high ARA stocks and slack demand from the key German inland market also depressed prompt premiums.
Gasoline was steady to slightly lower but a healthy U.S. appetite and active cargo interest supported prices. Naphtha was mixed with cargoes steady and swaps still well supported.
High sulphur cracked fuel oil eased again on good supply and limited end-user demand.
